editorial_diagram_candidates.claim: For a relative d×d square patch, logical failure produces a self-avoiding rough-to-rough primal path P⊆E△R with d≤|P|≤n and at least half of its edges in the actual error chain E.
editorial_diagram_candidates.concrete_content: Draw the relative d×d primal patch with the left and right rough boundaries, the d vertical cuts, a self-avoiding path P joining those boundaries, and distinguish P∩E from P∩R. Mark P⊆E△R by showing each path edge in exactly one of E or R; annotate the cut-crossing lower bound |P|≥d and the equal-partition consequence |P∩E|≥ceil(|P|/2).
editorial_diagram_candidates.reason_uncertain: The exact path and cardinality argument are already stated and proved algebraically; the grid schematic would make the geometric witness and cut count easier to see but is not needed for correctness.

editorial_diagram_candidates.claim: On the periodic torus, the two primal Z supports are fundamental cycles and the two dual X supports are dual cycles crossing them; all four are nontrivial logical Pauli classes.
editorial_diagram_candidates.concrete_content: Draw a periodic square cellulation with one horizontal and one vertical primal cycle labeled Z̄₁ and Z̄₂, and the two transverse dual cycles labeled X̄₁ and X̄₂; identify horizontal/vertical primal edges and crossed dual edges, and indicate that the paired primal-dual supports intersect once while same-type generators form the two fundamental winding classes. Align labels with the exact products in line 36.
editorial_diagram_candidates.reason_uncertain: The formulas and winding-parity supplier make the geometry precise in text, and a torus projection must be drawn carefully to avoid suggesting nonperiodic boundaries; the diagram is a reading aid rather than proof evidence.

uncertainty_observations.evidence: In several link-heavy paragraphs, an opening parenthesis remains at the end of a text line, followed by an inline item link forced onto subsequent line(s), with its closing punctuation on a separate line. The math itself remains legible and intact; this is a layout observation, not a confirmed LaTeX/TikZ defect.
uncertainty_observations.disposition: Not classified as a confirmed rendering defect; retain as an optional layout observation for the consolidated report.
